propositions: The loud refusal at _pai_check_config prevents base_url and api_key configuration despite being documented as supported and parsed by config.py
An openai builder must be registered in the provider factory to construct OpenAIChatModel with custom base_url, gated on cfg.base_url being set so the openai SDK remains optional
The builder must override model_profile to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False for opaque endpoints while preserving other capabilities, preventing silent failures on custom servers

base_url is provider configuration not provider selection; REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER still chooses the provider and base_url only determines whether rebar constructs it (injecting endpoint) or defers to pydantic-ai
The openai SDK must be added to dev dependencies only, preserving the agents runtime extra as lean while allowing CI to validate the end-to-end recipe against OpenAI-compatible servers
providers.py must remain under 300 LOC and _pai_check_config must become validation rather than refusal, with clear errors for api_key without base_url and non-absolute base_url
